body:
### Size

S

### User value

I typed 1500.5 grams and the app told me to enter a weight above zero, which I had.

### Done when

- A weight with a decimal part is rounded up to the next gram before it is quoted.
- The screen shows the fee for 1500.5 g as it does for 1501 g.
- An error with no known code shows "The fee could not be quoted.", never the empty-parcel message.

### Design

none
title: A weight with a decimal point is answered with "Enter a weight above zero."
